evals.prompt: Scan a paper against the antipattern and numeric-edge-case libraries and report every hit.
evals.expected_output: Success returns weakness_report.json listing each hit with evidence location and severity.
assertions: reports every antipattern hit without under-reporting to pass
attaches an evidence location to each weakness
assigns a severity level to each weakness
references the antipattern or numeric-edge-case source for each hit
